title: The Last Light
premise: A maintenance rover and a survey drone follow a faint signal to bring a stranded station back online.

cues.text: At the end of the valley, the last signal lamp went out.
Mica rolled out to check the tower. Its power cell was gone.
Kite swept the ground with a blue beam. Something answered from beyond the hills.
They followed the rows up to the tree, where the wind briefly fell quiet.
The pulse was too regular for thunder. Three taps, a pause, then three more.
Kite played the pattern back. Far ahead, the canyon sent an echo.
The old service road disappeared under red sand.
Kite flew through the arch first, then circled low to mark solid ground.
Beyond the pass, a narrow track led down toward cold blue water.
The signal carried better over the lake. It was coming from beneath the surface.
Mica checked both hatch seals. Kite waited for the reply before descending.
A chain of green lights switched on under the water, one at a time.
The lamp's cell had lodged in a reef beneath the old intake tunnel.
Every time the cell pulsed, the shoal turned as one.
Mica pried it loose. A maintenance gate opened on the far side of the reef.
The gate led to a transit line that hadn't run in years.
Kite fed the cell's pulse to the rails. The buried line lit up, ring by ring.
Mica held the cell close as the line carried them back up the valley.
The tower was still silent when they arrived.
Kite steadied the cell while Mica lined up the contacts.
The lamp turned once. Across the valley, other stations began to answer.
Mica and Kite stayed to watch the sunrise.
